title: 纸上的三十天  (Thirty Days on Paper)

segments.t: Back behind the front desk, Manager Zhou sits slumped beside the brass key board while Chen and Qing lean across the counter speaking in low voices. Listen first.
擦亮铜钥匙、整理领带十五年……三十天就全没了！
整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
对啊！刚才我看见第一页后面还别着第二页。
法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
这栋老房子挺过了八十个冬天，昨天还修好了阀门。
等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
吃柠檬蛋糕的两兄弟？
一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
等等——小美正从他们那桌走回来呢。
Now let's go through the scene, one line at a time.
整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
'We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.' Fighter's expression
认输
literally 'admit defeat', so Chen tells Zhou 'don't admit defeat early!'.
法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
'Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!' Glasses, gloves, and chess sets use
副
for one complete matched set: 'two pairs of glasses'.
这栋老房子挺过了八十个冬天，昨天还修好了阀门。
'This old house survived eighty winters, plus a broken valve yesterday.' Enduring hard times uses
挺过
literally 'stand tall and pass through'—surviving eighty winters.
等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
'Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?' Standard metric distance word
米
serves for 'metre', sharing its character with uncooked rice.
脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
'Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.' Chen's praise literally says 'brain spins fast'—Mandarin's lively image for quick wits.
哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
'Oh dear, how could we bother a paying guest with our landlord troubles!' Dropping 'not' from 'embarrassed' gives
好意思
asking 'how could I have the nerve to bother a guest?'.
我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
'After we guarded his blue suitcase all week, he will gladly help!' Helpful everyday pair:
愿意帮忙
joins 'willing' with 'help a busy hand'.
等等——小美正从他们那桌走回来呢。

'Wait—Mei is walking back from their table right now.' Notice how 'from their table walk back-come' anchors the starting spot before the movement. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
擦亮铜钥匙、整理领带十五年……三十天就全没了！
整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
对啊！刚才我看见第一页后面还别着第二页。

一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
等等——小美正从他们那桌走回来呢。

Qing remembered they have an expert on historic courtyard buildings sitting ten metres away under their shade tree. Next time, Mei brings out the lemon cake and Peng notices the worried faces inside. See you next time.
回头见！
